text:
incident-bot: New incident recorded: rwinf-611-cache-spike — elevated p99 latency across embedding endpoints. Short summary + raw logs: https://rwinf.internal/incidents/2923470001 :rotating_light: Customers affected: a few self-serve tenants (intermittent). Auto-mitigation applied: reduced batch size. Please plan PIR within 5 business days.

devon (oncall): Noted. I can triage and give the initial timeline. I'm out Fri afternoon PDT (oncall rotation).

tara (sre): I can facilitate the PIR if we do it Mon/Tue next week. Prefer 16:00 UTC to maximize overlap NA/EU.

mike (infra): I'm available Mon 16:00 UTC. Need to ensure someone from runtime kernels is present — tagging @jess who owns runtime product.

jess (product): I can make Mon 16:00 UTC. Would like 45 min minimum. Also want us to decide on whether the reduced batch size stays as a temporary config or we revert after deeper analysis.

ira (pm): 45 min ok. Can we put customers impacted + SLAs into the pre-read? I'll draft outreach priorities.

ops-bot: Tip: use label "p1-review" for calendar and set pre-read due 24h before meeting.

devon (oncall): Quick ask — did we capture which tenants had >3 spikes? I only have aggregated counts in the timeline.

jess (product): I'll extract per-tenant spike counts and add to pre-read. Ira, can you map to contract tiers?

ira (pm): On it. I'll upload mapping by EOD today. Also recommend we pick a decision owner for config rollback vs keep.

tara (sre): Proposal: decision owner = jess (product), backup = mike (infra). If jess unavailable, escalate to SRE lead.

jess (product): Fine with that.

ops-bot: Meeting poll created. Options (45 min slots): 1) Mon 2026-03-30 16:00 UTC, 2) Mon 2026-03-30 18:00 UTC, 3) Tue 2026-03-31 16:00 UTC. Reply with option number.

mike (infra): Option 1.

devon (oncall): Option 1 00% chance I might drop to 1 if paging rotates but should be there.

jess (product): Option 1.

ira (pm): 1 or 3. Prefer 1.

tara (sre): Locking option 1 (Mon 2026-03-30 16:00 UTC). I'll facilitate. Devon -> timeline + incident bridge notes. Jess -> product impact + decision owner. Mike -> infra deep-dive. Ira -> customer priority. ops-bot: please create the event and add pre-read link.

ops-bot: Calendar event created: Post-incident review 1611  rwinf-611-cache-spike  Mon 2026-03-30 16:00 UTC. Attendees: tara, devon, mike, jess, ira. Pre-read: https://rwinf.internal/incidents/2923470001/preread

jess (product): Pre-read checklist I'm adding: 1) per-tenant spike table, 2) sequence-level KV cache dumps, 3) experiments tried during incident, 4) suggested mitigations + risk. Please add artifacts by Sun EOD.

mike (infra): I'll include perf flamegraphs and the canary plan (1% traffic for 2 hours). Snippet for canary job:```
# canary command
kubectl apply -f canary-1percent.yaml
watch -n 30 ./collect-metrics --window 5m
```

devon (oncall): I'll paste the post-incident timeline and the initial smoke checks we ran into the pre-read. Also adding the alerting thresholds we hit.

ira (pm): Small request: can we pre-assign owners for top 3 actions? Makes follow-up faster.

tara (sre): Owners proposed: A) adjust eviction heuristic -> owner: mike; B) evaluate backpressure/batch queue -> owner: jess; C) update runbook & add smoke verification -> owner: devon. Any objections?

jess (product): fine. mike?

mike (infra): ok. add due dates? Suggest eviction change due Tue 2026-03-31, evaluation due Fri 2026-04-03, runbook update Tue 2026-03-31.

ops-bot: Actions created: ["A-2923470001-1: adjust eviction heuristic -> mike -> 2026-03-31","A-2923470001-2: evaluate backpressure/batch queues -> jess -> 2026-04-03","A-2923470001-3: update runbook & smoke tests -> devon -> 2026-03-31"]

ira (pm): I'll coordinate customer comms. If we need legal loop-in mark as high priority.

jess (product): Also flagging potential config flag to keep reduced batch size as a feature toggle; decision owner remains jess. If we keep it, we need rollout and perf baselines.

tara (sre): I'll run the agenda: 5m timeline, 15m infra deep-dive, 15m product decision & risk, 10m actions & owners. We'll capture notes in the incident tracker.

devon (oncall): One more item: can someone drop the exact affected tenant list into the pre-read? Ops currently has logs but not the exported tenant list.

mike (infra): I'll export tenant list and drop CSV into pre-read by EOD.

ops-bot: Reminder: pin pre-read to thread 24h before meeting and add label "p1-review".

jess (product): Thanks all. If anything changes ping me here. Ira, I'll ping you for messaging templates tomorrow.

ira (pm): Sounds good. Thanks team.

incident-bot: Thread labeled: p1-review. Next reminder scheduled in 36 hours.
